name: Find a destination and open a travel plan
description: Verifies the core storefront flow from destination search to a selected eSIM plan.
steps: Type Japan into the destination search
Choose Japan from the search results
expected: A secure checkout modal is visible for Japan Essential with 5 GB, 15 days, and the displayed IDR price.

name: Create an iPaymu sandbox payment session
description: Verifies ROAMINK can create an iPaymu hosted sandbox payment session without charging real money.
steps: Open the Indonesia Essential plan checkout
expected: The checkout creates a sandbox payment session and redirects to an iPaymu hosted payment URL.

name: Show a useful checkout error
description: Verifies an upstream checkout failure is visible and the customer is not redirected.
steps: Open the Japan Essential plan checkout
expected: A visible checkout error message appears and the payment form remains usable.

name: Show My eSIM activation state
description: Verifies customers get a clear state while live order access is not yet enabled.
expected: A visible message explains that My eSIM access will activate with live orders.

name: Use device help and open verified contact details on mobile
description: Verifies mobile visitors can use compatibility guidance and reach the public business contact details required for merchant verification.
steps: Press Check compatibility and confirm the guidance is readable
Scroll to the footer and open Contact
expected: The contact page is readable on mobile and shows nadmostudio@gmail.com, 0822-4797-2288, and Jl. Sekarwaru No. 17B, Sanur, Bali, Indonesia.
